scenarios.review_note: Original pending_user_approval semantic review preserved. User 71-room production delegation explicitly includes improving the existing office representative; no other occupation or alternative is approved.

interaction_flow.reduced_motion: Inspector reducedMotion or in-game intro/pause button 화면 움직임 줄이기: 켜짐/꺼짐; when enabled the original selection/restore transition completes immediately. Kept across same-run room leave/return.
interaction_flow.input_lock_policy: Block room pick/orbit/zoom while surface open and all work commands while transition/paused/ended. Field typing does not activate global P/R/digits/arrows.
interaction_flow.close_policy: Esc/close retains unsaved document draft, selected file/revision, copies, classification, handoff draft; cancel transient gesture only; restore original camera/background.
interaction_flow.pause_policy: Explicit pause freezes printing and active-time measurement. Work-surface close/Esc inside PAN-001 keeps the started print timer running. Navigating from PAN-001 to another room suspends the office run and its print timer; returning to PAN-001 resumes the same in-memory run from the retained elapsed print time. Focus loss cancels transient gestures and excludes active measurement, without creating termination.
interaction_flow.reset_policy: Confirm path reset, terminalize unfinished prior run with USER_RESET, preserve ledger/summary, reset Session printing state, assign a fresh scenarioRunId, clear UI drafts/camera/focus. After an ended experience, new local practice creates a new experienceId.
interaction_flow.persistence_scope: session; in-memory across room changes. Refresh retains original received records/checkpoint only, not playable workflow restoration.

scene_leave_policy.when_navigating_elsewhere: Pause OfficeSession and print timer; retain elapsed print time, drafts/settings, run ID and reduced-motion preference.
scene_leave_policy.when_returning: Resume same in-memory run and continue retained print timer.
scene_leave_policy.different_from_work_surface_close: Closing the monitor/copier/cabinet work surface while staying in the office keeps printing active.

protocol.terminal_scope: interaction completion differs from scenario completion; end aggregates current run and retains prior resets separately.
protocol.run_history: unique events; counters derived once in Unity; reset preserves previous run; replay same event IDs; request retry same cached response.
protocol.interruption: checkpoint and original received history retained; unknown forced/disconnected exits not fabricated as user abort.
